title: Chiếc ghế trống
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): G minor in 3/4 at 60 bpm. It opens and closes on the cellos plucking softly, a heartbeat, under the piano's sparse chords. Its motif falls a sixth (G5-Bb4), from where someone was to the empty place, then climbs three steps back (C-D-Eb). The climax comes early, second, in B-flat with the strings and the piano's rolled chords, the sixth now falling from D6 and Eb6; then a long settling: the piano alone; the plucked heartbeat back with the violas at the sentences' ends, the tune low; the motif once more over the heartbeat. An original tune.
